title: Bootstrap Rust CLI
description: Create the installable Rust binary, package metadata, clap command surface, and prime/help command for the agent-orchestrator project. Keep the CLI usable without Herdr installed and report clear errors for unavailable integrations.

title: Read SQ dependency tree
description: Implement the SQ JSONL reader, task model, scope selection, dependency validation, and ready-task calculation. SQ is the contract; detect cycles, missing blockers, unrelated tasks, plan drift, and tasks already owned by another run.

title: Manage Herdr agent panes
description: Implement Herdr integration for creating named workspaces or panes, launching OMP agents with task context, retaining pane/session handles, observing process state, and reporting unavailable Herdr cleanly. Keep the integration behind a narrow driver boundary.

title: Correlate identities and handoffs
description: Integrate agent-id current/discover and AgentMail JSON sends. Generate complete handoffs containing orchestrator identity, task ID, queue path, worktree, branch, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and message receipts; reconcile agent reports with SQ transitions.

title: Provision worktrees and reconcile runs
description: Implement worktree and branch provisioning, canonical queue sharing, runtime ledger, leases, status reconciliation, blocked/failed/lost worker handling, and a finish loop that unlocks dependent SQ tasks without silently retrying or merging.

title: Test install and workflow
description: Add behavior-focused tests for graph readiness, scope, handoffs, unavailable integrations, and state transitions. Add the agent-facing prime manual and command help, document installation and local assumptions, and run the focused checks.
